schoolReviews.review: I like the small private like atmosphere. I do not like how these kids are being raised up at home to be snobs.

McSwain has always been a great school. I am so happy to see the great reviews. I left in 1984 and left California in 1997. My son and daughter are both enrolled at Colorado State. Life flies by so fast. The teachers at that little school were so good to me. Cherish and let your children enjoy those precious years.

We moved here recently, and I really like this school and this area. The housing in this area is very cheap compared to equivalent housing just 15 minutes away in North Merced. You can get a very nice house for $300K that would cost $600 in Merced. The school community is tight, and the teachers are nice. The only reason I gave it four stars instead of five is because I have several friends whose kids are excluded from "clicks" in this school. Hopefully this doesn't happen to my child. Right now, I'm liking it. Even though I'm driving about 20 minutes to work.

servingThisHomeSchools.fullAddress: 1800 N Buhach Rd, City of Atwater, CA 95301

schoolReviews.review: The school does a tremendous job of meeting the needs of students despite being a large school.
Honestly how do I even explain this, they have the right ideas but wrong execution

I graduated in 2016. I can attest to the AP curriculum that it is top notch. Common core has tainted the common core curriculum like a virus but that's every school now. BCHS as of 2015 was ahead in technology in most areas. Chromebooks are used effectively to supplement learning. BCHS has a great band and theater program and is the only high school in Merced County to incorporate an engineering academy as an option. The AP teachetrs are the best you will find. AP Chemistry with Camp is the best chemistry you will find in California. The arts are also excellent, Freitas is a personal favorite as well as, Newton go APUSH. Admin is great although I'm sure it has changed since I have left. BCHS strives for school pride and unity. Thy gyms not bad. Overall its the best high school in the area for sure.
my experience in this school is meh

Well im currently a student at buhach and I thoroughly enjoy the school, the staff are great and funny, especially Mr. Freitas, the school is clean and kept up very well, and is also very well organized, my only issue is that recently we students and staff are being required to wear a photo ID at all times and receive a small punishment if found without one, though it is justified with all the craziness going on in the world.

schoolReviews.review: This K-12 campus is great for families with home school students or those students who might have anxiety on public campuses, for kids who want to focus on learning and not all the social drama of a traditional school; it is great for kids who are on travel teams because, students only meet once a week with a standard teacher and then they can ask for more of the offerings like: college classes from Merced College, cooking, full math classes, business and marketing, computers, horticulture and more. Every student has their own educational roadmap. It does require a student who can study from home, but a very unique and high technology campus!

this k-12 school is great they offer a lot of fun and interactive activities, this school is good for kids that want to learn from home and not have to go to school with all the drama that comes in high school.i would definitely recommend this school to anyone.

This school is really great. They offer many stuff such as clubs and electives. The teachers are amazing and the staff is very nice. They have many fun activities as well. I would definitely recommend this to your kids.

schoolReviews.review: Sheehy is a typical inner town central valley school where resources are limited. Caring staff don't always believe in the population they serve, but none the less commit to doing the best they know how. Leadership from the district lacks guided direction for effective academic advancement and is too politicized; but our child has taken advantage of the opportunities provided. There is a heavy self-reliance on student achievement - staff development is still at the talking stages for the most part - but intentions are good. Our child is expected to keep focus where none is provided and to leverage the strengths of the teachers where it exists. We are encouraged by the optimism expressed by parents and staff.

It's not a substitute for the professional advice of a lender or financial planner. By using this tool, you're agreeing to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
buyingPowerInfo.mortgageCTADisclaimer: Rocket Mortgage is an affiliate of Redfin. You aren't required to use its lending services. Learn more at redfin.com/afba.
buyingPowerInfo.affordabilityDisclaimer:
We use your income and monthly debt to come up with your debt-to-income ratio, or DTI. We base your buying power on your DTI. We calculate your buying power based on a DTI of 36%, which is the general rule around how much of your income should go toward debt.

The ranges below will help you understand if you have enough income to live comfortably for the selected home price. A general guide is to budget around 28% of your pre-tax income for your mortgage payment, and another 8% for other debts.

Affordable: 0%-36%
Stretch: 37%-50%
Ambitious: Above 50%
